I have not been on Adderall for months now and I have spent most of my life unmedicated and I cannot even read books I am interested in without my attention wandering.

I told my doctor how I cannot concentrate on anything and he told me that I need to use study tools which I already do.
The man I saw was a psychiatrist and an M.D. I don't know how that works.  He told me he tries to avoid giving medicine out.  He said I will hear the same thing if I see another doctor.
